examples.sentence: A strike on the Buenos Aires underground has caused traffic chaos and large queues at bus stops in the Argentine capital.
Indonesia's government has confirmed it is considering raising fuel prices by as much as 30%.
Scandal-hit jet fuel supplier China Aviation Oil has offered to repay its creditors $220m (£117m) of the $550m it lost on trading in oil futures.
The US budget deficit is set to hit a worse-than-expected $368bn (£197bn) this year, officials said on Tuesday.
Novelist Andrea Levy is favourite to win the main Whitbread Prize book of the year award, after winning novel of the year with her book Small Island.
The reggae industry is to refuse to release or stage concerts featuring homophobic songs under a global deal struck with gay rights groups.
The parents of a 13-year-old girl are suing US supermarket giant Wal-Mart over a CD by rock group Evanescence that contains swear words.
The new big-screen version of The Magic Roundabout, released in the UK on Friday, is the latest attempt to turn children's television into box-office gold.
Michael Howard has backed stem cell research, saying it is important people are not frightened of the future.
Prince Harry should personally make clear how sorry he is about wearing a Nazi uniform to a friend's fancy dress party, says Tory leader Michael Howard.
Schools must improve the quality of citizenship lessons - or social cohesion and democracy will suffer, says the education watchdog.
New rules on marriage for foreign nationals living in the UK are coming into force.
Mexican outfit Red Sharks Veracruz hope to sign Juninho if the Brazilian decides to leave Celtic frustrated at his lack of first-team action.
Mark Lewis-Francis says his Olympic success has made him determined to bag World Championship 100m gold in 2005.
Two moments of magic from Brian O'Driscoll guided Ireland to a workmanlike victory against Italy.
Four British athletes have been pre-selected to compete at the World Cross Country Championships in March after impressive starts to the season.
Pocket-sized devices that let people carry around video and images are set to have a big year in 2005, according to industry experts.
Sci-fi shooter Doom 3 has blasted away the competition at a major games ceremony, the Golden Joystick awards.
Security firms are warning about a Windows virus disguising itself as an electronic Christmas card.
UK broadcaster Virgin Radio says it will become the first station in the world to offer radio via 3G mobiles.
